# Read in packages, functions, and directories
```{r}
source(paste0(here::here(), "/1-Config/config.R"))
```
### Getting percent identity for putative hits and all closest references

# NCBI hits (n=4093)
```{r}
# remove hits that were not inserted properly or are too far (Moorella thermoacetica)
hits_final_ages <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/hits_final_ages_no_MA.rds")) %>%
  # removes one of archaeoglobus hits that wasn't removed in other spots but had no bearing on results
  filter(is.na(distance) | distance <= 2.50) %>%
  #remove one of the hits from the three exact duplicates ("ORJZ01.17253.1_1/2-182", "OWUN01.41726.1_1/1-246", "OWAH01.53685.1_1/1-179")
  distinct()

# make txt file of NCBI hits to blast
write_lines(hits_final_ages$hit_id, file = paste0(refIdentityDir, "hits_all.txt"))
```

# for the rest of the project, only one hit per contig was selected when there are multiple hits to the same contig with different single_closest_ref. I want to get the identities for all 4093 putative hits, though, so this OTUs list is 40 instead of 36 (35 without archaeoglobus)
```{r}
OTUs_to_ref <- hits_final_ages %>%
  mutate(hit_id = hit_id,
         OTU = str_extract_all(closest_ref, "'[^']+'")) %>%
  unnest(OTU) %>%
  distinct(OTU) %>%
  mutate(OTU = str_remove_all(OTU, "'"))

write_lines(OTUs_to_ref$OTU, file = paste0(refIdentityDir, "OTUs_to_ref.txt"))
```

# CapScan hits (n=331)
```{r}
### Read in datasets from dm_abundance
samples_unique_gene_casette <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/samples_unique_genes_with_names_no_2018.rds"))

#looking to see which contigs are mapping to several species
contigs_multiple_refs <- samples_unique_gene_casette %>%
  group_by(contig) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(single_closest_ref) > 1)%>%
  # filter out contigs where multiple species are both Bilophila species or both D. piger; we don't care about these
  # want to fix the contigs mapping to species that are farther apart on the tree
  filter(!all(grepl("Bil|piger", single_closest_ref))) %>%
  summarize(
    n_refs = n_distinct(single_closest_ref),
    refs = paste(unique(single_closest_ref), collapse = "; ")
  )

### choose a representative subunit
# manually select a subunit for the 6 contigs found in contigs_multiple_refs
partial_genes <- c("Capsule_14.k141_153065_1", "Stool_14.k141_240693_1", "Stool_9.k141_270672_1")
unknown_species <- c("Capsule_7.k141_250498_14", "Stool_7.k141_215370_50")
# and rename 113757 to D. piger based on blast results

samples_unique_subunit_manual <- samples_unique_gene_casette %>%
  filter(!geneNum %in% partial_genes) %>%
  filter(!geneNum %in% unknown_species) %>%
  mutate(single_closest_ref = ifelse(contig == "k141_113757", "Desulfovibrio_piger__DslPige3", single_closest_ref))

## value of 331 comes from this
samples_unique_subunit_RPKG <- samples_unique_subunit_manual %>%
  filter(single_closest_ref != "Moorella_thermoacetica_Y72_copy_2__MooTher5") %>%
  group_by(contig, sample) %>%
  slice_max(RPKG, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

write_lines(samples_unique_subunit_RPKG$geneLoc, file = paste0(refIdentityDir, "hits_capsule.txt"))
```

# read in blast results from cluster
# NCBI
```{r}
NCBI_blast <- read_csv(paste0(refIdentityDir, "out/NCBI_blast.txt"), col_names = FALSE) %>%
  rename(hit_id=X1, ref=X2, percent_id=X3, query_cov=X4, evalue=X5)
  
closest_refs_tree <- hits_final_ages %>%
  mutate(OTU = str_extract_all(closest_ref, "'[^']+'")) %>%
  unnest(OTU) %>%
  mutate(OTU = str_remove_all(OTU, "'")) %>%
  rename(ref=OTU)

closest_refs_blast <- NCBI_blast %>%
  left_join(closest_refs_tree, by = c("hit_id", "ref")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(biosample_id))

single_closest_refs_blast <- closest_refs_blast %>%
  left_join((hits_final_ages %>% select(hit_id,single_closest_ref)), by = c("hit_id"="hit_id", "ref" = "single_closest_ref")) %>%
  group_by(hit_id) %>%
  filter(ref == single_closest_ref)

(nrow(single_closest_refs_blast %>% filter(percent_id >= 90))/
  nrow(single_closest_refs_blast))

ggplot(closest_refs_blast, aes(x = percent_id)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity")
ggplot(single_closest_refs_blast, aes(x = percent_id)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity")

# the only hit that did not have one of its closest references cross the evalue threshold was 
#ORVI01.95990.1_1/7-122
```
# CapScan
```{r}
capsule_blast <- read_csv(paste0(refIdentityDir, "out/capsule_blast.txt"), col_names = FALSE) %>%
  rename(hit_id=X1, ref=X2, percent_id=X3, query_cov=X4, evalue=X5)

capsule_single_closest_refs_blast <- capsule_blast %>%
  left_join((samples_unique_subunit_RPKG %>% select(geneLoc, geneNum, single_closest_ref, sample)), by = c("hit_id"="geneLoc", "ref" = "single_closest_ref")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(geneNum)) %>%
  distinct()

(nrow(capsule_single_closest_refs_blast %>% filter(percent_id >= 90))/
  nrow(capsule_single_closest_refs_blast))

ggplot(capsule_single_closest_refs_blast, aes(x = percent_id)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity")
```
